record.question: A & B together can do a piece of work in 6 days. If B alone can finish it in 8 days, then A alone can complete in
record.explanation: Together they complete 1/6 of the job daily; B completes 1/8. A therefore completes 1/6−1/8=1/24 daily and needs 24 days, option C. Verified worked solution; unofficial.
